The '''N-s8.6 Navcon computer system''' was manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]], and was the primary [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] of the [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]] [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboat]].
